hotels.title: Maldives All-Inclusive Island Glamour with Unlimited Free-Flow Drinks & Return Speedboat Transfers
hotels.description: Live like royalty from the moment you arrive at the glamorous Villa Nautica, conveniently positioned just a 20-minute speedboat transfer from Malé. Sprawled across its own private island, the resort's social atmosphere emanates from seven restaurants, complemented by several bars, giving it a lively character that sets it apart from quieter, more secluded Maldivian retreats. Dining is a true strength of Villa Nautica, led by the buffet of Bageecha and strengthened by six further restaurants. Bageecha runs all-day dining across three sittings: a buffet breakfast with tropical fruit and pressed juices, plus lunch and dinner featuring Maldivian and Asian dishes alongside a full spread of continental options. Menus rotate regularly, with dedicated vegetarian, pescatarian and gluten-free choices throughout. The Lagoon, reserved for Water Villa guests, serves international dishes from its overwater setting with dawn-to-dusk ocean views; Hook serves fresh seafood at the end of the jetty; Ristorante al Tramonto brings Italian to an open-air terrace; and Fukuya Teppanyaki offers live Japanese cooking theatre. Press & Pot and Dhaavani Coffee Shop round out a dining programme that keeps guests well fed from morning coffee to late evening. Families will find the resort particularly well suited to travelling with children, with the Wavy Navy Kids' Club dedicated to guests aged four to 12. All packages welcome kids under 12 to stay free with activities and dining included. Araamu Spa, water sports equipment, scuba diving, surfing and the Crow's Nest lookout complete a resort that always has something going on. Surfers can go further afield, with boat trips available from the resort to North Malé Atoll's recognised reef breaks, including Sultans.
